comment: The Copperbell Mines' first boss, Kottos (BNpcBase 14460, layout 9053767): 9970 HP, level 17, appears as the first door opens. Its schedule counts from its pull (`from_pull`), to the tenth of a second the same in all three of Bob's runs (Chronofoil captures of 2026-10-25: bd298651 visit 0.5 with Duty Support, 69bea0b9 visits 0.1 and 0.3 in the Duty Finder), however long after its spawn it was pulled (5.2-10.0 s): auto-attack 870 at 3.0 s and every 3.0 s while it isn't busy; 28545 at 5.2 s, 28543 at 15.3 s (then its leaps: the director; no auto-attacks from 28543 until 28546 lands), 28546 at 29.6 s, 28547 at 39.1 s, 28543, 28546 and 28547 again 37 s later; then from 86.2 s every 81 s: 28545, 28543 13.2 s after it (99.4 s in), and so on. Past 81 s only the Duty Support run (101 s) shows it. Times here are the tick (0.5 s) the cast begins in. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members. 28549 and its helpers' 28544 never caught anyone: their amounts are stand-ins, 28546's.
